patch.summary: Is Lemlist worth it? Multichannel cold outreach platform (email, LinkedIn, SMS, dialer) with lead database and enrichment credits — Email plan from list price (yearly headline), Multichannel from list price, Enterprise custom, 14-day free trial. Landscape cold-email/outbound infra…. Strong when Teams whose primary job is multichannel cold outreach (email + LinkedIn). Weak when Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer.

sections.heading: Lemlist: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact data and Teams whose primary job is multichannel cold outreach (email + LinkedIn) holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Cold-outreach first — not an SI mega-database peer would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Email, Multichannel, Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who Lemlist is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose lemlist when multichannel cold outreach is the job — treat it as SI landscape cold-email coverage, not a ranked contact-database pick..

Avoid if: Compare Instantly/Smartlead for cold-email infra; Outreach/Salesloft for enterprise SEP; Apollo/Hunter when data+light outreach is primary..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Instantly on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Lemlist price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
Prove one real workflow on the documented free/trial path before arguing for Email.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
